name: aura-indexer
description: AURA v2 on-chain event indexer (Ponder 0.16). Indexes AgentRegistry + OutputNFT + AuraMarketplace on 0G Galileo from the deploy block, derives the dashboard/discovery/feed read models, and serves them from the Ponder process via Hono API routes (PGlite-backed). Replaces the Phase-2 brute-force chain loops.
